---
name: Feature request / RFC
about: Propose a new feature, language change, or stdlib addition
title: "[RFC] "
labels: proposal
assignees: ''
---

## Summary

One-paragraph summary of the proposal.

## Motivation

Why is this needed? What problem does it solve?

## Detailed design

The concrete syntax and semantics. For language changes, include:

- Grammar production (if applicable)
- Examples of the new construct
- Examples of what remains invalid
- How it maps to Python

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches were considered and why they were rejected.

## Impact

- Which components are affected? (parser, transpiler, stdlib, CLI, docs)
- Is this a breaking change?
- Does this require a syntax change? (note: syntax is frozen until post-1.0)

## Post-1.0 note

If this requires a syntax change, it will be considered for post-1.0.
Label this issue `post-1.0-syntax` if applicable.
